scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. A room in Angelo's house.

lines.text: Every letter he hath writ hath disvouched other.
lines.plainText: Every letter he hath writ hath disvouched other

lines.text: In most uneven and distracted manner. His actions show much like to madness; pray heaven his wisdom be not tainted. And why meet him at the gates and redeliver our authorities there?
lines.plainText: In most uneven and distracted manner His actions show much like to madness pray heaven his wisdom be not tainted And why meet him at the gates and redeliver our authorities there

lines.text: I guess not.
lines.plainText: I guess not

lines.text: And why should we proclaim it in an hour before his entering, that if any crave redress of injustice, they should exhibit their petitions in the street?
lines.plainText: And why should we proclaim it in an hour before his entering that if any crave redress of injustice they should exhibit their petitions in the street

lines.text: He shows his reason for that: to have a dispatch of complaints, and to deliver us from devices hereafter, which shall then have no power to stand against us.
lines.plainText: He shows his reason for that to have a dispatch of complaints and to deliver us from devices hereafter which shall then have no power to stand against us

lines.text: Well, I beseech you, let it be proclaimed.
lines.plainText: Well I beseech you let it be proclaimed

lines.text: Betimes i' th' morn I'll call you at your house.
lines.plainText: Betimes i' th' morn I'll call you at your house

lines.text: Give notice to such men of sort and suit
lines.plainText: Give notice to such men of sort and suit

lines.text: As are to meet him.
lines.plainText: As are to meet him

lines.text: I shall, sir. Fare you well.
lines.plainText: I shall sir Fare you well

lines.text: Good night.
lines.plainText: Good night

lines.text: This deed unshapes me quite, makes me unpregnant
lines.plainText: This deed unshapes me quite makes me unpregnant

lines.text: And dull to all proceedings. A deflowered maid;
lines.plainText: And dull to all proceedings A deflowered maid

lines.text: And by an eminent body that enforced
lines.plainText: And by an eminent body that enforced

lines.text: The law against it! But that her tender shame
lines.plainText: The law against it But that her tender shame

lines.text: Will not proclaim against her maiden loss,
lines.plainText: Will not proclaim against her maiden loss

lines.text: How might she tongue me! Yet reason dares her no,
lines.plainText: How might she tongue me Yet reason dares her no

lines.text: For my authority bears so credent bulk
lines.plainText: For my authority bears so credent bulk

lines.text: That no particular scandal once can touch
lines.plainText: That no particular scandal once can touch

lines.text: But it confounds the breather. He should have lived,
lines.plainText: But it confounds the breather He should have lived

lines.text: Save that his riotous youth, with dangerous sense,
lines.plainText: Save that his riotous youth with dangerous sense

lines.text: Might in the times to come have ta'en revenge
lines.plainText: Might in the times to come have ta'en revenge

lines.text: By so receiving a dishonoured life
lines.plainText: By so receiving a dishonoured life

lines.text: With ransom of such shame. Would yet he had lived.
lines.plainText: With ransom of such shame Would yet he had lived

lines.text: Alack, when once our grace we have forgot,
lines.plainText: Alack when once our grace we have forgot

lines.text: Nothing goes right; we would, and we would not.
lines.plainText: Nothing goes right we would and we would not
